scope: Synthetic standard-library tests of finalize_content only; no experiment raw responses read, model calls, real-stage finalization, frozen code changes or live-runtime interaction.

historical_initial_run.interpretation: Historical pass evidence only. Root changed the module during delayed native startup; this run does not certify one stable implementation hash.

final_run.duration_limit: The unittest-reported duration excludes native command startup delay. It is not a model-performance or service-latency benchmark.

coverage: Exact 10000-unit and 100.00-percent totals, canonical code mapping and 2-decimal percent formatting
Exact normalization/rounding delta conservation and per-component rounding error below one unit
0.92 total, eleven-way ties, thirds, precision-sensitive 1e-40 near tie
Permutation invariance, positive scaling invariance, already-grid identity, idempotence and zero preservation
Strict rejection of negative, nonfinite, boolean/string/null, missing, duplicate and malformed vectors/JSON
Pre-Fraction digit/exponent resource guard and Decimal-platform-overflow exception handling
Submitted constraint changes caused separately by scaling/rounding without clipping
Malformed/duplicate constraint IDs, invalid bounds, malformed containers and JSON-serializable results
interpretation_limits: These are 32 software test methods, not 32 financial observations or independent semantic judgments.
Raw model validity and the frozen planned-case denominator remain unchanged.
raw_budget_within_1e_6 is an exact-rational derived diagnostic, not replacement for the frozen float-based eligibility rule.
Full CLI artifact binding, terminal accounting, active-stage safety and actual-stage application are outside this pure-function test receipt.

errors.reason: All 32 synthetic mathematical, parsing, precision, bounds and serialization tests passed on stable module/test bytes.

consistency.reason: Final source and test hashes are unchanged across the run; four original schema/calculator/analyzer/contract files remain unchanged. The earlier unstable-source test history is retained separately.

paper_topic.reason: Tests establish deterministic 100% finalization and transparent adjustments, not source interpretation, semantic repair, institutional correctness or investment performance.
